accepted_sources.title: Mathematical Morphology Operations on Grayscale Image
accepted_sources.language: Arabic abstract and English body; journal from Iraq
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full 11-page PDF opened and read; journal landing page also opened. Counted as one work.
accepted_sources.finding: Structuring-element size and shape govern erosion/dilation; opening removes narrow bright features and closing removes dark details. Morphological gradients can produce different edge/noise trade-offs than Sobel; transfer requires mask-specific testing.

accepted_sources.title: Segmentación de Imágenes en Color utilizando Histogramas Bi–Variables en Espacios Color Polares Luminancia/Saturación/Matiz
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full HTML article page and abstract read; PDF download could not be fetched, so full-paper reading is not claimed.
accepted_sources.finding: Uses luminance/saturation/hue polar spaces, bivariate HS and LS histograms, watershed-based morphological clustering, inverse projection, and saturation-based combination of chromatic/achromatic partitions. Authors note failures where histogram clusters overlap.

accepted_sources.title: Índice para a avaliação de segmentação de imagens
accepted_sources.read_depth: Journal landing page and abstract read; linked PDF not read.
accepted_sources.finding: The IAVAS_mod proposal compares a segmentation to a reference using polygon count, centroid distance, area difference, perimeter difference, and overlap range. This motivates multiple boundary/shape metrics rather than one pixel score.

accepted_sources.title: Deep learningを用いた生物電子顕微鏡画像のセグメンテーション
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full J-STAGE metadata and Japanese abstract read; PDF not read.
accepted_sources.finding: Deep-learning segmentation reduces manual annotation effort, but preparing training labels and calibrating model outputs remain bottlenecks. Transferable lesson: keep human QA and correction effort measurable.

accepted_sources.title: 基于前背景特性的逆光交通场景图像增强
accepted_sources.read_depth: Full accessible article page, Chinese abstract, English abstract, and references read; full text unavailable through the page.
accepted_sources.finding: Separates foreground/background using Otsu, applies LIME globally, separately equalizes background channels, then uses Canny-detected seam edges and adaptive filters to reduce black seams. This is enhancement research, not a validated matting algorithm.

accepted_sources.title: TIFO: Introduction à la morphologie mathématique
accepted_sources.finding: Explains connectivity, structuring elements, erosion/dilation, opening/closing, and operator properties including idempotence. Notes OpenCV channel-order pitfalls (BGR vs RGB); connectivity and footprint choice should be explicit in mask cleanup.

accepted_sources.title: Alpha matting using robust color sampling and fully connected conditional random fields
accepted_sources.read_depth: Institutional record and complete available abstract/metadata read; publisher full text unavailable. Counted once by DOI, not as separate Chinese/English mirrors.
accepted_sources.finding: Variable-size search windows expand foreground/background sample candidates for unknown pixels, then a fully connected CRF refines the matte at pixel level. Avoid overly local sampling when true color samples are absent nearby.

accepted_sources.title: RenderMatte: Exact-Alpha Rendering and Group-Relative Alignment for Image Matting
accepted_sources.read_depth: ArXiv HTML abstract, introduction, alpha-edge loss, and group-relative alignment method sections read; complete experiments/appendix not read.
accepted_sources.finding: Combines diffusion-model adaptation with an alpha-edge objective and multi-scale Laplacian boundary loss; post-training compares mattes under the same trimap using alpha accuracy, boundary fidelity, trimap compliance, and compositional consistency. Promising research, not independently benchmarked here.
